name: keeping Flow and Notebook production running within the allowance
from: Queued Flow orders and a Notebook usage reading exist and the accounts are signed in.
to: Each day's Flow bucket is spent before the daily turn and the month's remainder evenly to renewal (flowPacingPlan over content/config/flow-credit-model.json); capacity no order claimed is recorded in idle.jsonl with what lapses; Notebook usage is read and its windows respected; nothing unrequested is generated to use up capacity.
cost: Bounded attention to the allowance plan and the credit journal; the credits themselves are the subscription's, spent only on queued orders.
otherwise: Granted credits lapse unseen: the day's bucket is replaced at the turn and the month's remainder is lost at renewal.
receiver-condition: The thread's assayer, or an office of its opener, reads the evidence (the allowance plan and idle record, the hold and recovery result, or the migration report and operating-observation record) and accepts or declines it; the lead never receives its own work.
